Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

meta5number 0.2.0

  • The engine of the exact moments is now the package orderStatMoments, renamed from osmoments, and every call and the Imports field follow it. Install it with remotes::install_github("ZWuLab/orderStatMoments").

  • The package is renamed meta5number (it was fivenumMeta in 0.1.0), so that the name says what it is for: meta-analysis from five-number summaries. The functions, their arguments and their results are unchanged. library(meta5number) replaces library(fivenumMeta), and the old installation should be removed first (remove.packages("fivenumMeta")).

  • The constants of the shortcut formulas c_mu_shortcut() and c_sigma_shortcut() carry two decimals, as Table 3 of the paper and its supplement table print them since the refit on the paper’s grid of 40 sample sizes (n = 901 added). The anchors keep four decimals, since they are the limits of the paper’s Theorem 1. The documented errors were recomputed and are of the same size as before (at most 0.42% on the grid for the BLUE’s formulas). The constants of 0.1.0, for the record: BLUE, mean, S1 (2.006, -0.810), S2 (0.142), S3 (0.838, -0.576); SD, S1 (0.8278, 0.330, 1.2041), S2 (-0.863), S3 (5.267, -10.364, 8.327); Wan-Luo-Shi version, mean, S1 (2.006, -0.811), S2 (0.142), S3 (0.835, -0.572); SD, S1 (0.8705, 0.418, 1.2199), S2 (-0.845), S3 (5.191, -10.204, 8.525).

  • The test grid of test-exact-any-n.R has 40 sample sizes (n = 901 added).
